title: Unemployment Benefit Claims Filing, Backdating and Proof-of-Employment Limits
content:
The program limits on moving a claim effective date earlier and on filing an application of Unemployment Benefit Claims are these. A figure of 0 means the facility or limit is not available or not applicable to that program.

| Program | Maximum backdating (weeks) | Backdating request window (calendar days after the requested earlier effective date) | Application deadline (calendar days after the disaster declaration announcement) | Late application limit with good cause (weeks after the announcement) | Proof of employment or self-employment due (calendar days after filing) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Regular State Unemployment Insurance | 4 | 60 | 0 (no deadline) | 0 | 0 (no separate proof deadline) |
| Unemployment Compensation for Federal Employees (UCFE) | 4 | 60 | 0 (no deadline) | 0 | 0 (no separate proof deadline) |
| Unemployment Compensation for Ex-Servicemembers (UCX) | 4 | 60 | 0 (no deadline) | 0 | 0 (no separate proof deadline) |
| Combined Wage Claim (CWC) | 4 | 60 | 0 (no deadline) | 0 | 0 (no separate proof deadline) |
| Extended Benefits (EB) | 0 (not available) | 0 (not available) | 0 (no deadline) | 0 | 0 (no separate proof deadline) |
| Trade Readjustment Allowances (TRA) | 0 (not available) | 0 (not available) | 0 (no deadline) | 0 | 0 (no separate proof deadline) |
| Disaster Unemployment Assistance (DUA) | 0 (not available) | 0 (not available) | 30 | 26 | 21 |

## Notes

- Backdating is available only where the maximum backdating figure is above zero, so it is available to the Regular State Unemployment Insurance, UCFE, UCX and Combined Wage Claim (CWC) programs.
- The application deadline, the late application limit and the proof deadline are figures of the Disaster Unemployment Assistance (DUA) program only.
